rule GoldenTicket_TGT_Flags {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Kerberos TGT with suspicious flags indicative of Golden Ticket"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1558.001"
    strings:
        $ticket_flags_forwardable = "FORWARDABLE"
        $ticket_flags_renewable = "RENEWABLE"
        $ticket_flags_initial = "INITIAL"
    condition:
        all of ($ticket_flags*) and not $ticket_flags_initial == "INITIAL"
}
